description: Resource load and a folded timeline on the Svelte 5 data grid's Gantt view. A resource field says who is on each task and the histogram under the chart sums them per column, one row per crew, turning red where a crew is booked past its capacity - so a double-booked specialist is visible without reading a date. Capacity is per resource, so a two-van crew takes two jobs at once while one person does not. Folding weekends out of the axis leaves a hatched gap where each one was and fits a quarter in the width a month used to take, with working days keeping their real size.

faq.question: What does a bar in the load strip count?
faq.answer: How many of that resource's tasks overlap the column. On a day or week axis that is concurrency: three bars over Tuesday reads 3. Only leaves are counted, so a phase does not book its owner twice for its children's work.

faq.question: How is a resource's capacity set?
faq.answer: Name a field on each resource with the histogram's capacityField and give it a number; anything above it is drawn red. Without one every resource takes one task at a time.

faq.question: What does folding weekends out actually change?
faq.answer: Only the axis. Each run of non-working days shrinks to a narrow hatched marker instead of two empty columns, while working days keep their normal width, so a long plan fits on screen. A task that does run over a folded weekend still draws across it.
